Modified: registered into the BodyParts3D frame (similarity/affine + smooth warp; the spinal cord by its vertebral column), brain hemisphere labels corrected, 8 mislabelled Allen brain meshes renamed after the structure they show, dense meshes decimated.

sources.title: HuBMAP Human Reference Atlas - 3D Reference Organ Set for Female, v1.10 (united female body)
sources.attribution: Browne, Kristen, and Heidi Schlehlein. 2026. 3D Reference Organ Set for Female, v1.10. https://doi.org/10.48539/HBM637.DWBM.744. HuBMAP Human Reference Atlas, CC BY 4.0. Organs used: skin, mammary glands, female reproductive tract and its ligaments, uterine vessels, kidneys and ureters, urinary bladder, liver, gallbladder, biliary tree, pancreas, small and large intestine, omentum, mouth, salivary glands, teeth, palatine tonsils, heart, cardiac and abdominal vessels, lungs, larynx and tracheobronchial tree, spleen, thymus, vertebral column, sacrum, coccyx, ilium, sternum, knee bones/ligaments/menisci, rectus femoris, eyes with extraocular muscles and optic nerves, spinal cord, brain (Allen Human Reference Atlas - 3D, 2020). Modified: translated into the Body Explorer female frame; brain and uterine round-ligament L/R labels corrected; 8 mislabelled Allen brain meshes renamed after the structure they show; Allen brain centred on the body midline (2 mm); dense meshes decimated. Not used: full-term placenta, generic lymph node, tissue-sampling patches.
